title: Sing Woo Dan

page_data.en:
703
Shanghai Municipal Council.
November 8th 19/6

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A memorial service will be held in Sing Woo Dan 新舞台
theatre in the City on 12th inst in honour of Daung Chi
Sung 唐继星 Chuh Ling Sze 阙麟书 and several other
Shanghai rebels who were executed between August 1913
and May 1916.
The Arsenal will commence work by night as well as
by day on Friday 10th inst.
The City Magistrate has received a petition from the
Pootung gentry asking for permission and co-operation
in making roads at Pootung. One of the proposed roads
will run from the bank of the Whangpoo river opposite
Shanghai to Chu Po 七宝 and the other from Poh Tsa 北蔡
to Tsai Soo. 川沙
General Feng Kou Chang will be proclaimed Vice
President at Nanking to-day. The day is being observed
as a holiday in official circles in the City.
At General Li Tsung Woo's house on the 7th inst
186 passage tickets were distributed among 186 rebels
natives of Anhui and Chekiang. The sum of $2166.00 was
also handed to the leaders of the men for distribution.

Your Obedient Servant,
WB Newport /
Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
703
上海工部局。
1916年11月8日

警务处，
（侦探科）

先生：
本月12日，将在城内新舞台戏院举行追悼会，以纪念唐继星、阙麟书及其他几名于1913年8月至1916年5月间被处决的上海反叛者。
兵工厂将于本月10日（星期五）起，开始日夜开工。
县知事已收到浦东士绅的请愿书，请求批准并协助在浦东修筑道路。其中一条拟建道路将从黄浦江畔对岸上海处延伸至七宝，另一条则从北蔡延伸至川沙。
冯国璋将军今日将在南京宣誓就任副总统。城内官方机构今日将此日定为假日。
本月7日，在李宗武（音译）将军寓所，向186名籍贯为安徽和浙江的反叛者分发了186张船票。此外，还向这些人的首领交付了2166.00元，以供分发。

您顺从的仆人，
WB Newport /
侦探副督察。

警察总监
